احتفيتم (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَيْتُمْ (iḥtafaytum) /iħ.ta.faj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# اُحْتُفِيتُمْ (uḥtufītum) /uħ.tu.fiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
